name: n4_session_retro_draft
description: Draft the session retro: reads this server's audit and journal and returns markdown plus evidence-backed CANDIDATE kit deltas (refusals, bad read-back verdicts, in-doubt batches, BOX errors, dangling outputs). Proposes only; never applies or stages anything. An audit line that cannot be read is named in the summary, which says the draft is incomplete. The window starts at the server start; pass since (ISO-8601, e.g. 1970-01-01T00:00:00Z for the whole history) to change it.

since.description: ISO-8601 timestamp; only newer entries are considered (default: when this server started)
